legend.0: Prototype: works on one machine and one agent, offers no protection against pre-ingestion tampering, documentation in a single language.
legend.1: Useful to its author for personal cost tracking, but clear gaps block team use.
legend.2: Usable by a small team that standardises on the same agent tooling, with accepted manual setup and manual price entry.
legend.3: Usable by a team with mixed agent tooling and provides evidence strong enough for an internal review.
legend.4: Suitable for external audit or regulated use without further assurance work.
